result.title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
result.summary: In real-world deployments, large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly evolving from single-model invocation toward heterogeneous deployments in which different models are dynamically invoked for inference. When the same context is reused across models, however, each newly selected target model typically has to process it again, repeatedly incurring substantial computational costs. Therefore, we propose ACCT (Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer), which targets KV cache transfer between models of different scales within the same model family. ACCT transforms the KV cache produced by a source model into sparse KV states that can be directly consumed by a target model, thereby enabling cross-model reuse of context computation and decoupling context computation from downstream inference. ACCT consists of three lightweight components: the Cartographer identifies query-relevant context tokens for each target layer and KV head; the Allocator determines how many context tokens each target layer and KV head retains under a shared total KV budget; and the Compiler transforms selected source KV into sparse target KV. The target model can therefore perform inference using the transferred KV without reprocessing the original context. We evaluate ACCT in two complementary settings comprising five general-capability benchmarks and six highly context-dependent tasks. Experiments show that ACCT matches or exceeds the target model's original inference performance even when reducing the KV cache size by 75%. At a context length of approximately 19K tokens, ACCT's KV conversion achieves a 6.5-21.2 times speedup over target context prefill. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transferring context computation across models under a limited KV budget.

AI.brief_summary: ACCT 研究同一模型族内不同规模 LLM 之间的 KV cache 迁移：先用 Cartographer 为每个目标层与 KV head 找出与 query 相关的上下文 token，再由 Allocator 在共享 KV 预算下分配各层各头的保留量，最后由 Compiler 将源模型 KV 转为目标模型可直接使用的稀疏 KV，从而复用上下文计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按层/头筛选 query 相关 token 并在统一预算下分配稀疏 KV 的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态的计算预算分配以及跨模块 latent 复用提供可核查线索；但该工作为纯文本 KV 迁移，未涉及视觉输入或推理轨迹，迁移性需自行判断。
